QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_39

question.text: GST on fees paid by a Cat III AIF to external service providers (custodian, trustee, fund admin) is charged at the rate of:

explanation.text: The Logic: Financial services are taxable at 18% GST. AIFs cannot generally recover this GST as input credit (since AIFs don't provide taxable output services), making it a pure cost drag on NAV of ~0.4–0.8% of GNAV annually. The Trap: 12% is the concessional rate — not applicable. 28% is consumer-goods rate. 'Exempt' misreads the statute. Cross-Exam Context: Ch. 14 (Taxation) tests GST at a regulatory level; Ch. 7 tests the fee-structure impact. Manager's Pro-Tip: Negotiate gross-of-GST pricing with service providers where possible to lock-in total cost; GST-exclusive pricing leaves the fund exposed to rate-hike risk mid-contract.
